prior.author: author Ryan Newton <rrnewton@gmail.com> 1789614631 -0700
prior.message:
Preserve ordinary inode identity when standard descriptors are reused

[hermit2, degraded-unresolved, gpt-6-astra, devbig014, role=impl]

Plain Language Summary and Project Impact
Files and pipes reopened at descriptors 0 through 2 now use their ordinary
inode identity. Fixed standard-stream inode values apply only while those
slots contain inherited container streams. This repairs the measured KVM
fstat versus empty-path stat disagreement after descriptor reuse.

Task: kvm-lane-to-full-determinism-and-parity

Use the same resource guard for fstat, fdinfo, maps and anonymous proc-fd
readlink metadata. Preserve inherited-stream slot outcomes and existing alias
behavior. Extend the existing resource tests and keep the original closed-stdin
cat assertions first and unchanged, followed by descriptor-reuse controls on
native Linux, ptrace and KVM.

The fixture retains complete-stat-routes as a separate control. Its broader
proc-fd failure remains unresolved; this change does not claim to repair that
route or prove the cause of the historical cat loader failure.

prior.author: author Ryan Newton <rrnewton@gmail.com> 1789625771 -0700
prior.message:
Bind KVM mount identities to the actual backend namespace

[hermit2, degraded-unresolved, gpt-6-astra, devbig014, role=impl]

Plain Language Summary and Project Impact
KVM now retains the real completed-container mount identity order and validates
it against the namespace where the backend opens files. Public library callers
capture that same order before guest execution. This lets the shared Detcore
fdinfo and mountinfo normalization use actual descriptor and mount identities.

Task: kvm-lane-to-full-determinism-and-parity

Advance the maintained Reverie pin to landed 596b9adee8473dc0a7e62dce18580eead3d0c5c9,
which preserves owned proc-fd metadata and fdinfo semantics. Carry the existing
DBT 1050 effective-job-second threshold and 16-job clamp only after verifying
all build/vendor/config inputs are unchanged. The first updater invocation
retained its calibration refusal; the second completed the normal locked
workspace/all-target compile before applying this mount integration.

Require exact startup mount-order agreement before mutating captured config;
preserve root rewrites and genuine unlisted mount provenance, and remove the
obsolete synthetic 0:1 device mapping. Four focused config controls raise only
the two Hermit unit inventory declarations from 630 to 634. Generated commands,
selected populations, dependencies and resources stay unchanged.

The existing descriptor-reuse, complete-stat-routes and original closed-stdin
assertions remain unchanged. Their integrated runtime validation is pending;
this source change does not assert backend parity or discharge those checks.

prior.author: author Ryan Newton <rrnewton@gmail.com> 1789629276 -0700
prior.message:
Isolate descriptor fixture backend working directories

[hermit2, degraded-unresolved, gpt-6-astra, devbig014, role=impl]

Plain Language Summary and Project Impact
Run the appended ptrace and KVM descriptor-reuse controls from the existing
owned temporary directory, so a failing fixture does not write into the test
harness working directory.

Task: kvm-lane-to-full-determinism-and-parity

Preserve every guest argument, status/stdout/stderr assertion and the original
closed-stdin /bin/cat prefix. CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR continues to own fixture and
work-directory creation; the official HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR=/test path still
adds the same explicit private tmpfs and guest --workdir=/test. No test count,
selection, comparison policy or resource limit changes.

This is a test-only follow-up to the external a9 source review. Its official
24-method execution remains pending; prior aa7 descriptor/complete-mode results
are retained with their original source attribution.
